Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Rustic Metal Floating Shelf with 5 Hooks - 13 x 22 x 5 Inch, Black and Wood
Colors: Black
Materials: Stone
Along with vintage charm, this piece adds a convenient place to hang coats, purses and keys to an entryway or mudroom. The shelf is handy for mail or small objects you want to display. Wood and iron materials provide rustic and industrial touches. 22.5" W x 13" H x 5.75" D Constructed from hardwood and iron Ready to hang, all hardware included
